Library hours extended from March

Millbrook's public library will open until 9 p.m. on weekdays from March, the council said on Tuesday.

The extension is funded for one year from the reserve budget. Councillors said a review of visitor numbers will decide whether the hours continue.

items.title: Annual report: visits and lending
items.text: Visits to the library rose by 12 percent last year, mostly in the evening. Lending of printed books fell slightly, while e-book lending doubled. The report notes that the reading room was often full after 6 p.m.

items.title: Survey: what residents want from the library
items.text: A survey of 400 residents found that 61 percent wanted longer library hours on weekday evenings. Parking near the library was the most common complaint. Only 9 percent said they would visit more often on weekends.
